changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Favorite') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Favorite]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [ResourceID] [int] NOT NULL, [Route] [varchar](250) NULL, [Name] [varchar](250) NULL, [SortOrder] [int] NULL, [IsOverride] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_Favorite_IsOverride] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [Object] [varchar](50) NULL, [ObjectID] [int] NULL, [IsHomePage] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_Favorite_IsHomePage] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_Favorite_ID] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END

changeSet.author: Tklok
changeSet.sql:
IF (OBJECT_ID('dbo.DF_Favorite_IsOverride', 'D') IS NOT NULL) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Favorite] DROP CONSTRAINT DF_Favorite_IsOverride END GO
IF EXISTS (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'Favorite' and COLUMN_NAME = 'IsOverride') BEGIN alter table [dbo].[Favorite] drop column [IsOverride] END GO
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'Favorite' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Type') BEGIN alter table [dbo].[Favorite] add [Type] [varchar](50) NULL END GO
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'Favorite' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Uid') BEGIN alter table [dbo].[Favorite] add [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL END GO
UPDATE [dbo].[Favorite] SET [Type] = 'Page' WHERE [Type] IS NULL AND [Object] IS NULL; GO
UPDATE [dbo].[Favorite] SET [dbo].[Favorite].[Type] = 'AssetType', [dbo].[Favorite].[Uid] = at.[Uid] FROM [dbo].[Favorite] f INNER JOIN [dbo].[AssetType] at on f.Object = at.[Object] AND f.[ObjectID] = at.[ObjectID] WHERE F.[Type] IS NULL AND F.[Uid] IS NULL AND F.[Object] LIKE '%Type'; GO
UPDATE [dbo].[Favorite] SET [dbo].[Favorite].[Type] = 'Asset', [dbo].[Favorite].[Uid] = a.[Uid] FROM [dbo].[Favorite] f INNER JOIN [dbo].[Asset] a on f.Object = a.[Object] AND f.[ObjectID] = a.[ObjectID] WHERE F.[Type] IS NULL AND F.[Uid] IS NULL AND F.[Object] NOT LIKE '%Type' AND F.[Object] IS NOT NULL; GO

rollback.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'Favorite' and COLUMN_NAME = 'IsOverride') BEGIN alter table [dbo].[Favorite] add [IsOverride] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_Favorite_IsOverride] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL END GO
IF EXISTS (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'Favorite' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Type') BEGIN alter table [dbo].[Favorite] drop column [Type] END GO
IF EXISTS (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'Favorite' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Uid') BEGIN alter table [dbo].[Favorite] drop column [Uid] END GO

changeSet.author: Tklok
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (select * from [dbo].[Favorite] where [Type] is null) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Favorite] ALTER COLUMN [Type] [varchar](50) NOT NULL END GO

changeSet.author: Andrii Kunetskyi
changeSet.sql:
if not exists (select 1 from sys.columns where Name = N'AssetID' and Object_ID = Object_ID(N'dbo.Favorite')) begin alter table dbo.Favorite add AssetID bigint SPARSE end GO
if not exists (select 1 from sys.columns where Name = N'AssetTypeID' and Object_ID = Object_ID(N'dbo.Favorite')) begin alter table dbo.Favorite add AssetTypeID int SPARSE end GO
if not exists (select 1 from sys.columns where Name = N'SemanticID' and Object_ID = Object_ID(N'dbo.Favorite')) begin alter table dbo.Favorite add SemanticID bigint SPARSE end GO
update Favorite set AssetId = a.ID from Favorite f left join Asset a on a.Object = f.Object and a.ObjectID = f.ObjectID where f.Object is not null and f.Object != 'SemanticType' and f.Object not like '%Type' GO
update Favorite set AssetTypeId = at.ID from Favorite f left join AssetType at on at.Object = f.Object and at.ObjectID = f.ObjectID where f.Object is not null and f.Object != 'SemanticType' and f.Object like '%Type' GO
update Favorite set SemanticId = s.ID from Favorite f left join Semantic s on s.ID = f.ObjectID where f.Object is not null and f.Object = 'SemanticType' GO
if exists (select 1 from sys.columns where Name = N'Object' and Object_ID = Object_ID(N'dbo.Favorite')) begin alter table dbo.Favorite drop column Object end GO
if exists (select 1 from sys.columns where Name = N'ObjectID' and Object_ID = Object_ID(N'dbo.Favorite')) begin alter table dbo.Favorite drop column ObjectID end GO

changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[Favorite_AfterDelete] ON [dbo].[Favorite] FOR DELETE AS update f set f.sortorder = s.sortorder from favorite f join ( select id, resourceid, row_number() over (partition by resourceid order by sortorder) as sortorder from favorite) s on s.id = f.id join deleted i on i.ResourceID = s.ResourceID;

changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[Favorite_AfterInsert] ON [dbo].[Favorite] FOR INSERT AS update f set f.sortorder = s.sortorder from favorite f join ( select id, resourceid, row_number() over (partition by resourceid order by sortorder) as sortorder from favorite) s on s.id = f.id join inserted i on i.ResourceID = s.ResourceID;
